metadata.title: Watch me on MasterChef India starting 16 Oct 2023
metadata.description:
Bringing the hidden flavours of Meghalaya, Eat Your Kappa  ventures into MasterChef India! Will her culinary story on a plate captivate the judges?

Watch #MasterChefIndia. Streaming from 16th October, 8 PM, only on Sony LIV 

Ranveer Brar Chef Vikas Khanna #poojadhingra #DanishKhan #AmanSrivastav #SonyLIVInternational #sonylivinternational #sonylivindia #newseason
#MasterChef #MasterChef2023 #MasterChefIndia #MCInewseason #food #chefs #foodlover #cooking

Join me as I get a chance to cook on MasterChef India 2023! 

After a long hiatus due to school and farm commitments, I am back and better than ever. 

Available exclusively on Sony LIV, watch my journey through MasterChef India, to know what's on the horizon. 

Don't miss out!
